app.name: Asterism
app.tagline: Your private memory for open-source software.

login.brandTagline:
Remember the software
that mattered to you.
login.brandSubtitle: Sync GitHub Stars. Keep the reasons you saved them.
login.connectPrompt: Connect GitHub to sync your starred repositories.
login.scopesTitle: We only read this public information:
login.privacyNote: We don't change GitHub data or read private repositories. Your collection stays on your server. AI features send relevant content to your Provider.

importExport.title: Import / Export
importExport.subtitle: Back up or migrate your collections and memories
importExport.exportDescription: Choose a format for what you need.
importExport.importDescription: Restore collections and memories for synced repositories only. No repositories or Stars are added.

formatDescription.json: Complete backup with collection memberships and memories. Import it into Asterism to restore.
formatDescription.csv: Repository metadata for spreadsheets. Can't be used to restore data.
formatDescription.markdown: Repository links, collections, and memories for reading. Can't be used to restore data.

importExport.uploadHint: or drop an exported JSON file here
importExport.emptyDescription: Sync your Stars before exporting data.

export.title: Export selection
export.description: Export {{count}} repositories with their collections and memories. Your data stays unchanged.
export.error: Couldn't export. Your selection is kept. Try again.

formatDescription.json: Backup of selected repositories, collections, and memories. Importing merges data without deleting other content.
formatDescription.csv: Metadata for selected repositories. Use it in spreadsheets; it can't restore data.
formatDescription.markdown: Selected repositories with their collections and memories. For reading, not restoring data.

bulk.noCollections: Create a collection before organizing repositories.

bulk.terminalExplanation: Some repositories or collections are unavailable. These changes can't be retried.

ask.description: Answers use only your personal collection.

settings.title: Settings

settings.askDescription: Answer questions with your API Key. It is stored only in this browser.
settings.askConsentDescription: To answer, your question is sent to {{provider}} along with your complete Star catalog: names, languages, topics, and descriptions. With “Include notes” enabled, saved reasons and notes are sent as needed. Your API Key is stored only in this browser and forwarded to your chosen Provider with each request.
